subject: gk
question: Ker and Garia Puja are traditional tribal festivals of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ker and Garia Puja** are traditional tribal festivals celebrated in Tripura, a northeastern state of India.
 
• **Ker Puja** is dedicated to Ker, the guardian deity of Vastu Devata. It occurs approximately two weeks after the Kharchi Puja in August. The term "Ker" signifies "austerity" and in the Kokborok language, the indigenous tribal language, it denotes "boundary" or "specific area".
 
• **Garia Puja**, on the other hand, is the most significant festival in Tripura. It spans seven days, commencing on the final day of the Chaitra month and concluding on the seventh day of the Vaisakha month. The last day of the festival is observed as a regional holiday. During Garia Puja, rituals are performed by a priest known as Ochai.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Tripura,** pronounced is a state located in Northeast India. It is the third-smallest state in the country, covering an area of 10,491 square kilometers (4,051 square miles).
 
• Despite its small size, it ranks as the seventh-least populous state, with a population of 3.67 million people.
 
• The state shares its borders with Assam and Mizoram to the east, and with Bangladesh to the north, south, and west.
 
• Tripura is administratively divided into 8 districts and 23 sub-divisions, with Agartala serving as both the capital and the largest city in the state.
 
• Tripura boasts a diverse demographic composition, with 19 distinct tribal communities coexisting alongside a predominant Bengali population. The official languages of the state are Bengali, English, and Kokborok.
